tutorial.combo: Look for **three of the five cards summing to a multiple of ten**. Find one and you have a bull — the **three cards marked ★**.
tutorial.rank: **The remaining pair's last digit** is the rank. **Zero is Niu Niu**, the strongest; 1–9 are niu 1 through niu 9. No such triple at all is a **no-bull**, the weakest.
tutorial.multiplier: The payout follows the rank: **Niu Niu triples, niu 7–9 doubles**, the rest pays even. The **winner's** multiplier applies, so a banker's Niu Niu takes three times your stake.
tutorial.noChoice: There are **no decisions to make**. The five cards you are dealt determine the best hand, so the round resolves the moment you bet.
tutorial.controls: Buttons for the stake and the next round.

frontendHint.niuniuStakeCap: Your cap is chips divided by the top multiplier — a banker Niu Niu pays three times
frontendHint.niuniuStackTooShort: Your stack cannot cover the top multiplier on any stake
